promptText: Which hotel brands are commonly associated with branded residence development in Europe?

payload.rawResponseText:
In Europe, branded-residence development is primarily associated with **luxury and upper-upscale hotel operators**. The names most commonly encountered include:

### Leading individual hotel brands

- **Mandarin Oriental** — currently the leading individual brand by total completed and planned European projects.
- **Radisson Blu**
- **Four Seasons**
- **Six Senses**
- **Swissôtel**
- **Kempinski**
- **Radisson**
- **The Ritz-Carlton**
- **Mövenpick**
- **St. Regis**
- **Wyndham**
- **One&Only**

Savills’ European leaderboard—based on data as of **January 1, 2026**—places these brands among the region’s most active. Mandarin Oriental is projected to have 18 European schemes operational by 2032, followed by Radisson Blu with 12; Four Seasons and Six Senses share third place. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))

### Major parent hotel groups

At group level, the most relevant platforms are:

- **Marriott International** — especially **The Ritz-Carlton** and **St. Regis**, along with brands such as EDITION, W and The Luxury Collection. Marriott leads Europe by total branded-residence project count, with 37 completed and pipeline schemes. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))
- **Accor** — notably **Raffles, Fairmont, Swissôtel, Mövenpick, Sofitel** and selected lifestyle brands. Accor has Europe’s strongest development pipeline, with more than 21 schemes under development. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))
- **Radisson Hotel Group** — principally **Radisson Blu** and **Radisson**, with a particularly visible presence in Central, Eastern and Southern Europe. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))
- **IHG Hotels & Resorts** — principally **Six Senses**, and to a lesser extent Regent and InterContinental.
- **Hilton** — particularly **Waldorf Astoria, Conrad** and Hilton-branded residences.
- **Hyatt** — including Park Hyatt and selected luxury/lifestyle brands.

Other prestigious operators regularly associated with high-profile European residential schemes include **Raffles, Rosewood, Aman, Maybourne, Dorchester Collection and Bulgari Hotels & Resorts**, although their European portfolios are generally smaller and more selective.

In short, for a European development-branding exercise, the most established shortlist would usually begin with **Marriott, Accor, Mandarin Oriental, Four Seasons, Radisson, Six Senses and Kempinski**. Hotel brands still dominate the wider branded-residence sector globally, accounting for roughly four-fifths of existing schemes. ([knightfrank.com](https://www.knightfrank.com/research/article/2025-09-08-the-global-branded-residence-survey-2025?utm_source=openai))
